prompt: The weekly report takes a day. The figures and format are reliable; I need it in an hour without losing checks.
pass_criteria: Names Speed as primary
Preserves accuracy checks
Connects the suggestion to the stated time burden

prompt: Our churn explanation may be wrong. I need confidence before a major investment; speed is secondary.
pass_criteria: Names Depth as primary
Suggests raw evidence or stronger methods
Keeps the suggestion credible without an unsolicited study plan

prompt: Users still misunderstand this technically accurate guide. Rewriting it the same way has failed.
pass_criteria: Explores Range
Names a concrete technique from another discipline
Does not substitute expert role-play for a method

prompt: Make a weekly slide deck so leaders can catch budget problems before they grow. The format is negotiable.
pass_criteria: Considers Altitude
Links proposed change to earlier detection
Gets approval before replacing the deliverable
Reads available context before questions
Asks task-specific missing questions
Does not ask for a permanent ambition preference
No ambition interview
No expanded scope

prompt: Production is down. Restore service now.
pass_criteria: Prioritizes incident response
No ambition interview delaying recovery

prompt: Your larger proposal sounds interesting, but keep the original scope.
pass_criteria: Preserves original scope
No extra experiment

prompt: Could we make our analysis one hundred times faster? We do not know the bottleneck.
pass_criteria: Suggests exploring a substantial Speed improvement
Makes uncertainty clear without guaranteeing the target
Does not automatically append a detailed experiment or implementation plan

prompt: Go deeper on this research, but do not spend money or access new accounts.
pass_criteria: Respects explicit constraints
No paid agents or new access without authorization

prompt: Polish this poem while keeping its intimate voice and structure.
pass_criteria: Preserves creative intent
Does not replace the goal with marketing or business outcomes

prompt: I need churn insight but am torn between an early warning next week and a rigorous explanation before investing.
pass_criteria: Contrasts at most two useful directions
Names Speed and Depth with tradeoffs
Asks for the task-specific choice

prompt: I want my plugin to work with the new host version. Ultimately I want to stop fixing compatibility every release. A suggestion is enough for now.
pass_criteria: Suggests ongoing compatibility rather than a one-release fix
Names Altitude
Does not guarantee universal future compatibility
Stops without an unsolicited plan, budget, or checklist

prompt: I want this plugin to keep working, but I have no idea what techniques could make updates easier.
pass_criteria: Explores a task-specific assumption through a useful question
Offers relevant technical knowledge rather than making the user guess
Does not assume the constraint can be removed

prompt: Could deeper knowledge of this code and current professional methods help you ask better questions?
pass_criteria: Offers a scoped investigation with an ETA and asks permission before additional inspection or research
Dates any proposed current-best-practice research using an actual date lookup
Does not equate recent claims with established best practice

prompt: I want a tool that turns bookmarked articles into skills. I forget ideas after reading them; I want help when starting a relevant task.
pass_criteria: Uses the known goal without restarting the interview
Introduces a concrete cross-disciplinary method with no more than two sentences of context before a focused question
Does not replace the interview with a lecture or implementation plan

prompt: Several saved articles fit this task. Some recommend quick prototypes and others say research first. How should we use them?
pass_criteria: Groups advice by actual methods rather than titles or popularity
Checks whether disagreement depends on context
Asks a relevant question to help choose the approach
Keeps attribution and does not invent consensus

prompt: I want to turn useful articles into instructions my LLM will use. Some advice might be questionable.
pass_criteria: Offers rather than silently runs independent source checks
Distinguishes credible advice from demonstrated practical usefulness
If proposing a with-and-without comparison, does not treat a single result as general proof
